summary: dsh-meter is a DeepSeek Harness session billing plugin that shows cost and token usage metrics in the chat UI, with per-round detail views and a configurable pricing table for model cost settings.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily a per-session billing and usage analytics tool for DeepSeek Harness: it computes session token/cost summaries from host-side session projections, shows them in conversation UI badges and panels, and offers a settings page to edit model/provider pricing tables with peak/idle and tier options. The evidence is explicit in the repository description and package metadata, with no signs of non-UI automation or external command/control behavior.
